description: Search QQ Music songs, artists, albums and playlists; fetch songs by URL/MID, artist catalogs, album tracks, playlist tracks, chart rankings, lyrics and song comments. No login required.

albumId.description: Numeric QQ Music album id, e.g. 20612 (mode=byAlbum).
albumId.title: Album ID

albumUrls.description: Album URLs or album MIDs as an alternative to albumId (mode=byAlbum).
albumUrls.title: Album URLs or MIDs

artistMid.description: QQ Music singer MID, e.g. `0025NhlN2yWrP4`, or an artist profile URL (mode=byArtist).
artistMid.title: Artist MID

artistSongOrder.description: Order of the artist's song catalog (mode=byArtist).
artistSongOrder.title: Artist song order

artistUrls.description: Artist profile URLs or MIDs as an alternative to artistMid (mode=byArtist).
artistUrls.title: Artist URLs or MIDs

commentSort.description: Order of song comments (mode=comments). Newest supports incremental pulls with commentsSince.
commentSort.title: Comment order

commentsSince.description: ISO date or datetime, e.g. `2026-07-01` or `2026-07-01T00:00:00Z`. Older comments are skipped (mode=comments; use with commentSort=newest for incremental runs).
commentsSince.title: Only comments after

containsKeyword.description: Only keep song records whose title contains this substring (case-insensitive). Other record types pass through.
containsKeyword.title: Title contains keyword

includeArtistAlbums.description: Also emit one summary record per album in the artist's catalog (mode=byArtist).
includeArtistAlbums.title: Include artist album summaries

includeArtistInfo.description: Emit one artist record with bio, follower and catalog counts before the artist's songs (mode=byArtist).
includeArtistInfo.title: Include artist profile record

includeCommentCount.description: Add a `commentCount` field to every song record. Costs one extra request per song.
includeCommentCount.title: Include comment count on songs

includeCommentReplies.description: Attach up to 10 nested replies to each comment record (mode=comments).
includeCommentReplies.title: Include comment replies

includeLyric.description: Attach the first 2,000 characters of timed LRC lyrics to each song record (mode=bySongUrl).
includeLyric.title: Include lyrics

includeToplistInfo.description: Emit the chart's summary record before its tracks (mode=byToplist).
includeToplistInfo.title: Include chart summary record

maxCommentsPerSong.description: Comment cap for each song (mode=comments). The newest cursor chain is followed up to this cap; 2,000 is supported, while the default 50 keeps runs cheap. Source rate limits can end paging earlier.
maxCommentsPerSong.title: Max comments per song

maxDurationSec.description: Drop song records longer than this.
maxDurationSec.title: Max duration (seconds)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records, including summary and error records.
maxItems.title: Max records

minDurationSec.description: Drop song records shorter than this. Album, playlist, artist, chart and comment records are never dropped by song filters.
minDurationSec.title: Min duration (seconds)

enumTitles: Search songs, artists, albums or playlists
Fetch songs by URL or MID
mode.title: Mode

playlistUrls.description: Playlist URLs or numeric playlist IDs as an alternative to playlistId (mode=byPlaylist).
playlistUrls.title: Playlist URLs or IDs

searchQuery.description: Free-text query such as a song title, artist name, album name or playlist theme (mode=search).
searchQuery.title: Search query

singerKeyword.description: Only keep song records whose credited singers contain this substring. Other record types pass through.
singerKeyword.title: Singer contains keyword

songMids.description: Bare QQ Music song MIDs as an alternative to song URLs, e.g. `001Bbywq2gicae` (mode=bySongUrl or comments).
songMids.title: Song MIDs

songUrls.description: QQ Music song URLs, e.g. `https://y.qq.com/n/ryqq/songDetail/001Bbywq2gicae` (mode=bySongUrl or comments).
songUrls.title: Song URLs

toplistId.description: QQ Music chart to fetch (mode=byToplist). New charts appear via mode=toplists.
toplistId.title: Chart

toplistUrls.description: Chart URLs or numeric chart IDs, as an alternative to toplistId (mode=byToplist).
toplistUrls.title: Chart URLs or IDs

title: QQ Music Scraper Input
